t: Gatton | Destination-information | Queensland
s: Gatton, the bustling heart of the Lockyer Valley, is your ticket to a charming adventure. Nestled just an hour from Brisbane and 40 minutes from Toowoomba, this RV-friendly town boasts a 48-hour rest area near the CBD, making it a delightful stopover. With its breathtaking backdrop of rolling hills and the Great Dividing Range, Gatton beckons you to explore its diverse array of cafes, restaurants, and hotels, all serving up delectable meals and unbeatable coffee that'll leave your taste buds singing.
